understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through the KA59 puzzle levels by positioning every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+'. On levels with multiple '+' tiles, all goal tiles must be occupied by selectable pieces at the same time to trigger WIN and advance; completing all levels wins the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were turn/step-limited per level. CLICK targeted a grid coordinate: if a selectable piece was already selected, CLICK attempted to move that selected piece to the clicked tile; movement could fail if the destination was invalid or the path/action was blocked by walls/obstacles or other blocking rules (resulting in no position change). Directional actions like MOVE_RIGHT attempted to move the currently selected piece one tile in that direction, also failing when blocked. Selection persisted across turns; if no movement was possible or steps ran out before all goals were simultaneously covered, the level/run ended without a WIN.
